predictions.articleTitle: Al-Wasl FC vs Hatta SC Prediction & Match Analysis: Can New Boss Al-Balooshi Blunt Wasl's Attack?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Al-Wasl FC are projected to secure a regulation-time Home Win in an Over 2.5 contest driven by their 2.57 goals-per-game output against Hatta SC's 2.14 goals-conceded defense.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win backed by 18 goals in 7 league games and intact attacking core (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals supported by 3.35 combined lambda and 65.1% Poisson expectancy (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Al-Wasl clean-sheet 3:0 branch covering Hatta's 0.86 goals-per-game road attack (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Al-Wasl's 2.57 goals-per-game attack tests Hatta's new low-block defense.

spf.comment: Al-Wasl's 2.57 league goals per game, 15.86 shots per match, and intact frontline project a decisive edge over 13th-placed Hatta in a 2:1 or 3:0 home win.

over_under.comment: A 3.35 combined statistical lambda (65.1% Poisson Over 2.5) and Al-Wasl's 3.71 average league match goals support Over 2.5.

btts.comment: Al-Wasl's 1.14 goals conceded per league match and 57.2% Poisson BTTS rate favor Hatta finding one counter-attacking goal despite their low overall output.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects the top Poisson density combining Al-Wasl control with one away transition strike, while 3:0 covers the clean-sheet rout branch.

goals.comment: Three goals holds the highest Poisson share (22.0%) across both 2:1 and 3:0 scripts, with four goals covering a faster second-half breakdown.

bqc.comment: Al-Wasl's 50% first-half goal share and 100% sampled lead conversion support Win-Win, while Draw-Win covers early resistance from Hatta's new low block.
